summary: The bug remains in the inspected main checkout: Talk Mode stops observing an accepted run after fixed waits, even when the agent can run longer. This worker has read-only filesystem access and a Linux host, so it could not add the required failing regression, implement the fix, or obtain native macOS playback and Stop proof. No PR is ready.

actions.reason: An accepted slow run can finish after Talk Mode stops observing it.
Useful prior work from @Alix-007, not a landed fix or an open action target.
The executor needs a writable checkout and disposable macOS host before opening a fix PR.
